name: 2505D VP, Development
strategy:
Beale - Plan of Action

Role & Seniority Focus
- The target seniority for this remap will be:
- Director
- Senior Director

Step 1: Initial Review - Existing Mapping
- We will begin by reviewing all past projects and previously mapped profiles.
- This review will primarily include ex-hyperscaler candidates who have already been identified.
- Data centre experience will be treated as a mandatory requirement while validating all profiles.
- Any profile without clear data centre exposure will be excluded.

Step 2: Industry Focus & Validation

Our industry coverage will follow a priority-based approach:
- Primary focus:
- Data centre developers
- Hyperscale past company search as we need to recheck that once.
- Secondary focus:
- Real estate companies with an active data centre division (e.g., Prologis where data centre experience may not always be explicitly listed)
- Energy sector profiles, only who have clear and relevant data centre exposure

Step 3: Tier 1 Location Mapping (50-miles radius)

We will first fully exhaust Tier 1 locations before moving to the next tier.

Within Tier 1, we will assess all relevant industries (data centre developers, ex-hyperscalers, real estate, and energy) using the same seniority and experience criteria.

Tier 1 Locations:
- San Francisco
- Dallas
- Seattle

Step 4: Tier 2 Location Mapping

Once Tier 1 is completed, we will replicate the same approach - same seniority, same industry focus, and the same strict data centre experience requirement - for Tier 2 locations.

Tier 2 Locations will include:
- Chicago
- Northern Virginia
- Atlanta
- Phoenix
- Denver
- Las Vegas
- Los Angeles
- New York
- Austin
- Houston

Step 5: US-Wide Mapping
- After completing Tier 2, we will expand the search to US-wide locations.
- The same structured approach will be maintained:
- Director / Senior Director only
- Mandatory data centre experience
- Same industry validation criteria
